- Model consistently underestimates true price spikes, especially in early 30-day horizon; adjust forecast upward by 2–5% for sudden upward moves.
- Model overestimates mean price in early horizon, fails to capture sharp downward corrections after spikes; apply downward bias of 1–3% in 10–15 day windows post-spike.
- Sentiment history is flat (0.00) in all examples — no sentiment signal to override model — so do not adjust for sentiment unless sentiment > 0.10 or < -0.10.
- Model exhibits mean reversion bias: forecasts drift toward prior 30-day average, but true price often overshoots or undershoots that average — apply 1–3% correction in direction of true price deviation.
- Horizon-specific error: 30-day forecast is consistently too low in early 2024, especially after 38.5–39.0 range — add 3–5% upward bias for 30-day forecasts when recent price > 38.5.
- No event context provided — assume no external shocks; do not adjust for policy or market event unless explicitly stated.
